overview: AlphaSense is an AI-powered market intelligence platform that combines proprietary search technology, generative AI workflows, business documents, expert content, and financial data. Founded in 2011 by Jack Kokko and Raj Neervannan, the platform started as a search engine for financial research documents and expanded through acquisitions including Stream, Sentieo, and Tegus. The $930M Tegus acquisition closed in July 2024 and brought expert research, BamSEC, and Canalyst into the group. AlphaSense now offers both human-led and AI-led expert calls alongside its document intelligence platform.

history.narrative: AlphaSense launched in 2011 with co-founders Jack Kokko (CEO) and Raj Neervannan (CTO). The company describes its origins in Kokko's experience with manual investment research. It acquired Stream in October 2021, Sentieo in May 2022, Tegus in July 2024, and Carousel in October 2025. In June 2026, AlphaSense announced $350M in funding at a $7.5B valuation and an Accenture partnership. Its June release reported that its new Hudson Yards headquarters in New York City had opened.

servicesDetailed.name: Expert Calls
servicesDetailed.description: One-on-one consultations with pre-vetted industry experts through Tegus Expert Call Services. AlphaSense offers human-led calls, AI-led calls, custom expert recruiting, and recorded transcripts. Its published options include pay-as-you-go calls and prepaid packages.

servicesDetailed.name: Expert Insights (Tegus Transcript Library)
servicesDetailed.description: AlphaSense's November 2026 product page reports 300,000+ investor-led insights, coverage of 29,000+ companies, and 8,000+ monthly transcript additions. The October 6 release separately reports more than 300,000 expert interview transcripts covering over 24,000 private companies and over 7,000 public enterprises. Coverage definitions differ between these sources.

servicesDetailed.name: Channel Checks (AI Interviewer)
servicesDetailed.description: AI-led expert interviews launched August 19, 2025. AlphaSense says its AI Interviewer conducts live conversations with human market participants to investigate demand, pricing, and supply-chain developments. Its October 2026 AlphaSummit recap describes Channel Check Intelligence summaries across 750+ tickers, refreshed daily with links to supporting expert quotes and transcripts.

servicesDetailed.name: Generative Search
servicesDetailed.description: AlphaSense describes a multi-agent research system that combines qualitative content, structured financial data, and internal knowledge to produce cited outputs. Its February 2026 product update documents custom scheduled agents, slide creation, and a tool for checking generated insights against source content.

servicesDetailed.name: Deep Research
servicesDetailed.description: Launched June 10, 2025. AlphaSense describes an AI research mode that searches and synthesizes content into cited reports, including company primers, M&A screening, and meeting preparation. Enterprise Intelligence customers can include internal documents.

servicesDetailed.name: Generative Grid
servicesDetailed.description: AlphaSense describes a tool that applies multiple research prompts across documents and organizes the results in a table, with pre-built criteria for repeatable analysis.

servicesDetailed.name: Financial Data (via Canalyst)
servicesDetailed.description: AlphaSense offers financial statements, consensus estimates, company-specific KPIs, valuation metrics, M&A data, funding data, and comparables. Its Financial Data page advertises 4,200+ Canalyst models as checked in November 2026; an October 2025 acquisition release cited 4,500 companies, so the figures should not be treated as a consistent growth series. BamSEC provides SEC filing search tools.

servicesDetailed.name: Workflow Agents and Work Products
servicesDetailed.description: AlphaSense lets users automate recurring research and deliverables. Its July 14, 2026 release adds native PowerPoint and Excel AI assistants for creating decks and models, incorporating source material, and applying firm templates. Carousel, acquired October 7, 2025, adds AI-powered Excel modeling technology.

servicesDetailed.name: Enterprise Intelligence
servicesDetailed.description: AlphaSense describes connectors and uploads that make internal research searchable alongside external documents. An October 7, 2025 release reported 185% growth in Enterprise Intelligence deals without specifying the comparison period; this is a dated company claim, not a full-year 2025 result.

servicesDetailed.name: Monitoring & Alerts
servicesDetailed.description: AlphaSense offers customizable dashboards and real-time alerts for tracking companies, industries, and themes, with mobile access. Its June 23, 2026 Sentiment Indices release adds sector-level analysis of management language across earnings cycles.

servicesDetailed.name: SuperAnalyst and MCP
servicesDetailed.description: SuperAnalyst was announced June 3, 2026. AlphaSense documents research, code execution, persistent project memory, and creation of reports, slides, and spreadsheets. The November 10 guide labels it beta. The November 6 MCP help page describes an account-enabled beta connector limited to Generative Search Auto mode, with broader SuperAnalyst tools planned for later in Q4; this is narrower than the MCP launch article's agent-execution description.

servicesDetailed.name: Clinical Trial and Drug Data
servicesDetailed.description: Announced September 15, 2026, this offering connects clinical trials, regulatory approvals, drug labels, and patents to the AlphaSense research workflow for life sciences teams.

servicesDetailed.name: Market Research (including EIU)
servicesDetailed.description: An October 7, 2026 announcement adds EIU country and industry reports, macroeconomic forecasts, and geopolitical intelligence through a Market Research subscription offering.

aiPlatform.narrative: AlphaSense describes AI search, research synthesis, custom workflow agents, and an AI Interviewer that conducts calls with real experts. SuperAnalyst extends this to research execution and deliverable creation, but its November 2026 help documentation still calls it beta. The SuperAnalyst FAQ also says financial-data citations are still being rolled out and shared team projects are not yet available. These are company-described capabilities and limitations, not independent performance findings.

complianceExtended.narrative: AlphaSense describes a framework combining expert agreements, training, questionnaires, recorded calls, automated checks, and human review. clientFit.narrative: Editorial assessment: AlphaSense fits teams combining document-level market intelligence, financial data, and expert-sourced research in one workflow. Its published customer segments include investment banking, asset management, private equity, venture capital, corporate strategy, and life sciences. Buyers should obtain a platform quote and assess call services separately: Tegus advertises pay-as-you-go options rather than an annual call commitment.
